entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who travels 1,280 years back in time to change the moment that sealed Tarkir's fate.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane whose history is rewritten after the demise of its dragons.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon whose battle with Ugin sealed Tarkir's fate.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A colorless planeswalker and Spirit Dragon whose battle with Bolas led to his demise and that of Tarkir's dragons.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: A khan of the past whom Sarkhan meets.

entities.name: Clans of Tarkir
entities.description: The clans, not fighting each other in the past, who constantly fend off hordes of dragons.

entities.name: Battle between Bolas and Ugin
entities.description: The battle that ended with Ugin's demise and all the dragons of Tarkir.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol travels 1,280 years back in time to change the moment that sealed Tarkir's fate.
events.quote: Sarkhan Vol travels 1,280 years back in time

events.summary: In the past the clans, not at war with each other, are fending off hordes of terrorizing dragons.
events.quote: but are constantly fending off the hordes of dragons that are terrorizing their world

events.summary: Sarkhan meets khans of the past such as Yasova Dragonclaw, and Tarkir's history is rewritten.
events.quote: The history of Tarkir is rewritten.
